def_en: 1) to answer, respond, testify, speak, shout
1a2) to testify, respond as a witness
kjv: give account, afflict (by mistake for ), (cause to, give) answer, bring low (by mistake for ), cry, hear, Leannoth, lift up, say, [idiom] scholar, (give a) shout, sing (together by course), speak, testify, utter, (bear) witness. See also , .
expl: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
